fixture_05_bt_estimee_18mois_gaz_quantit.source_note: FACTURE ESTIMEE, 18 mois, Quantité gaz = 0 MAIS redevance gaz = 40 DT → presence_gaz = Oui
fixture_05_bt_estimee_18mois_gaz_quantit.known_production_bug_observed: Earlier prompt produced gaz = 4 m³ / 2.35 DT énergie / 25 DT redevance (correct: 0 / 0 / 40.000) and dates = 22/01/2024 → 28/04/2024 (correct: 2024-04-26 → 2026-04-22). Cause gaz: column shift (Nbre de Mois=4 as Quantité, Puissance/Débit=25 as redevance). Cause dates: digit contamination from other date fields. Covered by correctFactureBtExtraction + prompt anti-shift rules.
